cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The collapsed cake was foreshadowed by that first wobble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I allowed the audience to discover its significance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. The empty stand pays off the warning beautifully.

mechanism: A treats its former baking pupil cake collapse as a deliberately staged turn, converting remembered wobble and spare cream into planned trifle-making clues.
confusable: Not simply predicting accurately or learning from a loss: A claims to have arranged the failure as a planned change of activity using prior details.
comparison: Failed cake to claimed trifle plan versus fallen tent to claimed wet-weather lesson.
